label: Only this learner's live enrollments, in title order
code:
WHERE e.user_id = :user_id
  AND e.status <> 'cancelled'
ORDER BY c.title, c.course_id

label: Insert one active enrollment
code:
INSERT INTO enrollments (user_id, course_id, enrolled_at, status)
VALUES (:user_id, :course_id, :enrolled_at, 'active')

label: Exactly the enrollment to cancel
code:
WHERE user_id = :user_id
  AND course_id = :course_id
  AND status = 'active'
